viewing_check: Check the timber is solid (not rotten or punky) by tapping and probing the underside and legs; check stability on all legs and whether the splits run through; photograph from the back and the underside; measure length/height; look for species hints (heavy dense teak/suar vs light driftwood) and whether it can be moved by one vehicle.
